feed.subtitle: Find out recent news from the Data-Driven Process Systems Engineering (DDPSE) Lab at Georgia Tech School of Chemical & Biomolecular Engineering in Atlanta.

entry.title: Jacob Sweet and Sidharth Laxminarayan awarded Graduate Research Fellowships

link.title: Jacob Sweet and Sidharth Laxminarayan awarded Graduate Research Fellowships

entry.content:
We are excited to share that two PhD students from the DDPSE Lab have received prestigious graduate fellowship awards recognizing their research accomplishments.

  • Jacob Sweet has received the Eastman PhD Fellowship Award, sponsored by Eastman. This fellowship recognizes outstanding graduate students whose research demonstrates strong potential for scientific impact and innovation.

  • Sidharth Laxminarayan has received a ChBE Fellowship in recognition of his excellent research accomplishments and contributions to the School of Chemical & Biomolecular Engineering.

Congratulations Jacob and Sid!!!
entry.summary: We are excited to share that two PhD students from the DDPSE Lab have received prestigious graduate fellowship awards recognizing their research accomplishments.

entry.title: DDPSE Lab receives funding to work on new fertilizer recycling technologies

link.title: DDPSE Lab receives funding to work on new fertilizer recycling technologies

entry.content: The DDPSE Lab received new funding from the National Science Foundation Engineering Research Center for Advancing Sustainable and Distributed Fertilizer Production (CASFER). As part of the center, we will work with interdisciplinary teams to merge experimental data and mechanistic knowledge to build hybrid process models for novel sludge electrochemical reactors. These models are needed to enable the design and control of these processes under varying incoming waste stream properties. You can find more information about the center here.

entry.title: Congratulations Dr. Suryateja Ravutla!
entry.content: Dr. Suryateja Ravutla has successfully defended his PhD on “Developing Hybrid Modeling and Optimization Techniques for Process Systems”. Congratulations Surya!!! He will be moving on to a new position as a Senior Data Scientist at Aspen Tech (Bedford, MA), leveraging ML and advanced optimization techniques to develop AI-driven solutions for engineering systems.

entry.title: Sidharth Laxminarayan awarded Amyn S. Teja International Endowment Fund

link.title: Sidharth Laxminarayan awarded Amyn S. Teja International Endowment Fund

entry.content: Sid Laxminarayan is the recipient of the 2024 Amyn S. Teja International Endowment Fund, which will allow him to travel to Imperial College London to work with our international collaborators in the area of bioprocess modeling and control.

entry.title: Dr. Boukouvala and team of ChBE Professors awarded Himmelblau Award for Computer-Aided Chemical Engineering Education

link.title: Dr. Boukouvala and team of ChBE Professors awarded Himmelblau Award for Computer-Aided Chemical Engineering Education

entry.content:
Fani Boukouvala, Andrew Medford, Martha Grover, Carson Meredith and David Sholl were awarded the AIChE Computing and Systems Technology Himmelblau Award for innovations in Computer-Aided Education, for the creation of the Data-Science Certificate for the Chemical Industries.

You can watch the online webinar describing the program here: DSCI Webinar
and find more information about the Data-Science Graduate Certificate for the Chemical Industries here: DSCI Webpage
